mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (member_id, schedule_id, seat_id, status, created_at, updated_at, expired_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{scheduleId}, #{seatId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), #{expiredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id, member_id, seat_id, schedule_id, status, reserved_at, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT reservation_id FROM reservations WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expired_at IS NOT NULL AND expired_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expired_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = #{status}, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}
